faqs.question: Where is your showroom located and what are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: Our showroom is located at Plot 42, Furniture Hub, Ring Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka. We are open Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 8:30 PM, and Sunday from 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

faqs.question: What are your delivery charges and how long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: We provide free delivery across the city for orders above 3000 rupees. For orders under 3000 rupees, a nominal delivery fee of 250 rupees applies. Standard metro delivery takes 2 to 4 business days.

faqs.question: What is your return, replacement, or cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 7-day hassle-free replacement or return guarantee if the chair has any manufacturing defect, damage during transit, or fitment issue. Returned products must be in original condition with packaging.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), all major credit and debit cards, net banking, Cash on Delivery (COD) for orders up to 10000 rupees, and 0% interest EMI options on select bank credit cards.

faqs.question: Do chairs come pre-assembled or is assembly provided?
faqs.answer: All chairs arrive with complete DIY toolkits and visual manuals taking only 10 to 15 minutes to assemble. We also provide free technician assembly at your doorstep within 24 hours of delivery across major metro areas.

faqs.question: Can I visit the showroom for a chair demo or book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely! We encourage customers to book a 30-minute showroom demo appointment where our ergonomic specialist will set up chairs tailored to your height, posture, and work hours.

faqs.question: Do you offer corporate or bulk order discounts for offices?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer special corporate tier discounts starting from 10 chairs or more, including customized logo embroidery, customized fabric colors, and GST tax invoice credits.
